problem_type: Native walk success is not bound to complete guard, cleanup, cost and project-isolation facts
symptom: Missing guard log or normally returned cleanup failure can leave top-level functionalPassed true; marker tests omit the switched stream; unexpected loopback images can remain accepted.
direct_cause: Optional existsSync guard branch, count-only launch checks, catch-only finish handling and partial marker matching were copied into native receipt finalization.
class_root: Native functional claims have no one shared mandatory evidence boundary over actual launch identity, final runtime result, bounded request accounting and complete transcript marker families.
affected_population: Both Nomi native Agent receipt runners and future native functional receipts
Missing/empty/malformed logs, duplicate/unrelated PIDs, cleanup/collect errors, extra images/requests and foreign partial content
entry_points: Cross-project switch/cold-recovery finalization and all original transcript records
invariants: A missing/empty/malformed guard log cannot certify a native functional receipt
Every actual launch PID has exactly one complete five-layer guard record; no blocked/error event
Runtime finish must return passed with no error, exact declared text count and zero image/paid/unexpected calls
Every complete original transcript record excludes the other project marker family, including SWITCH_PROMPT/PARTIAL
Both native runners share the same evidence validator; actual cold original-byte equality is checked before archive redaction

door_reduction.why_not: Two native runners and their class regression retain distinct UI/report roles; both consume the same validator, and cross-project JSONL records consume the shared full-prefix predicate.

generality_proof: The generated five-door scan and repository search find both optional native guard branches; atomic project.open and next-action guards already reject missing logs and remain unchanged. One validator checks every native launch PID, runtime final result and final request counters; isolation inspects all original JSONL bytes for foreign prefix, not a message-only projection. Missing/duplicate PID/cleanup/image/partial regressions and CI/local exact argv parity prevent the same class returning through another native caller.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject functional certification unless all actual process/guard/finalization/cost facts agree
Reject foreign project marker families in any original transcript record

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Seven exact false-green classes reproduced RED; full final facts and isolation now shared
Same optional guard branch removed; capability blocker still exits1 and cannot certify whole-walk success
guardReceipt already throws on missing log/incomplete layers; unchanged measured-source hash
Unconditional read and layer assertions already fail missing/empty log; source unchanged

recurrence.reason: A different native caller, failed log write, second launch, hidden cleanup error or partial response can reach the same unsealed success claim.
same_class_scan: rg existsSync guardLog / guard-loaded / guardFailure across all Nomi runners
Read scripts/walkthrough-network-guard.cjs note(), agent-runtime-walk-support.mjs finalizeRuntimeWalk(), fixture image endpoint/assertClean and actual complete JSONL

prevention.invariant: Native functional success requires complete process/guard/finalization/cost evidence and project-isolated original transcript records.
prevention.failure_mode: Shared validator/predicate throws; caller clears top-level functionalPassed/evidenceValid and exits1 while preserving raw failure evidence.
prevention.strategy: Remove both optional inline guard branches; enforce actual PID identity and final runtime/cost facts at one validator, with full-record foreign-family predicate and mandatory Node gate.

legacy_paths.rationale: Both duplicated optional/count-only guard finalizers are deleted; production guard/runtime remain the owners of actual observations.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No runtime/dependency defect or new framework. This is the internal test receipt certification boundary.

migration: No production, transcript format, concurrency, permission or budget migration; existing real receipts remain immutable historical runs.
residual_risks: New-head CI pending after final normal push; final-source bounded real UI receipts passed and are archived
Same-window background concurrency remains unavailable under current per-sender workspace contract
Full-product metrics/matrix and real-display/Mac/Windows/GPU baselines remain unverified
internal_only_reason: The contracts are internal: existing walkthrough guard note(), finalizeRuntimeWalk() result/error semantics, fixture request counters and actual JSONL owner. Installed runtime behavior is retained; repository source and exact failure slice decide the invariant.
